name: QAM - Jira JQL to AI Summary to XLSX in Teams

nodes.name: Get Jira Issues
nodes.notes: Placeholder JQL — replace project key / sprint (or whatever filter you need) with your own before running. Attach your own Jira credential; don't reuse someone else's saved credential on a shared instance.

parameters.jql: project = QAM AND sprint in openSprints() ORDER BY priority DESC

nodes.name: Format Issues For Prompt
nodes.notes: Reduces the raw Jira issue array into (a) a compact text block for the AI Agent's prompt and (b) a per-issue row array reused later by the XLSX-building code node.

nodes.name: OpenAI Chat Model
nodes.notes: Model sub-node feeding 'AI Agent' via the special Model input (dashed connector), not a normal data link. Swap for Anthropic/Gemini/etc. if your org standardizes on a different provider.

nodes.name: AI Agent
nodes.notes: Summarizes the Jira issue set in one shot (no tools attached — this is a summarization step, not an autonomous agent). Output text lands in $json.output — confirm via 'Execute step' before trusting the field name downstream.

parameters.text:
=Summarize the following Jira issues for a Test Manager. Cover: (1) overall status mix, (2) any high/critical priority items still open, (3) one flagged risk if there is one. Only use information present below — never invent details.

{{ $json.summaryText }}

options.systemMessage: You are an assistant drafting an advisory sprint status summary. Be concise (under 150 words) and flag anything uncertain rather than guessing.

nodes.name: Prepare XLSX Rows
nodes.notes: Builds one consistent-schema row set for the spreadsheet: a leading 'AI SUMMARY' row holding the AI Agent's narrative, followed by one row per Jira issue.

nodes.name: Convert to XLSX
nodes.notes: Produces the binary XLSX from the rows above. File lands on binary property 'data' — referenced by the OneDrive upload node next.

nodes.name: Upload XLSX to OneDrive
nodes.notes: Microsoft Teams' node has no direct file-attachment operation (Teams channel files are backed by SharePoint/OneDrive), so the workbook is uploaded here first and linked in the Teams message next. Replace the placeholder parent folder ID with a real one — see 'Find the folder ID' in n8n's OneDrive docs.

nodes.name: Post Summary To Teams
nodes.notes: Posts the AI summary plus a link to the uploaded workbook into the target channel. Replace Team ID and Channel ID with your real ones (use the node's dropdown/list-search in the n8n UI rather than hardcoding once you're set up).

_scaffoldNotice: Hand-authored against documented n8n node types/params (n8n-nodes-base.jira, @n8n/n8n-nodes-langchain.agent + lmChatOpenAi, n8n-nodes-base.convertToFile, n8n-nodes-base.microsoftOneDrive, n8n-nodes-base.microsoftTeams). Every credential ID, folder ID, team/channel ID, and the JQL are placeholders — replace them, then run node-by-node with 'Execute step' before trusting the full chain, same as the Module 2 starter workflow.
